CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
July 11, 2023 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR PARKS AND RECREATION MONTH - It is recommended the City Council proclaim July 2023 as Parks and Recreation Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Community Services Director Oliver Osuna.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Melissa Skau and Andres Lemus and present them with a $40 gift certificate to Panera Bread restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.2 Introduction of New Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Special Joint Meeting of the City Council and Planning Commission held on June 27, 2023 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of June 27, 2023.
7.1 Minutes of Special Mtg 6-27-23
7.1 Minutes of 6-27-23 CC
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated July 11, 2023 in the total amount of $4,218,850.08.
7.2 Warrant Register
7.3
APPROVAL OF USE OF FACILITY – LA MIRADA HIGH SCHOOL FOOTBALL BOOSTER CLUB EVENT AT SPLASH! LA MIRADA REGIONAL AQUATICS CENTER BUCANEER BAY – It is recommended the City Council approve the use of facility for the Buccaneer Bay waterpark at Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the La Mirada High School Football Booster Club recreational event and waive all fees associated with the requested use.
7.3 Approval of Use of Facility
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2022-03, CITY HALL FOUNTAIN RENOVATION – FINDING THAT PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT OF 1970, THE PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT UNDER SECTION 15301 CLASS 1 (C) AND APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council find that pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act of 1970, the project is categorically exempt under Section 15301 Class 1 (c) and will have no significant effect on the environment; approve the plans and specifications for Capital Improvement Project No. 2022-03, City Hall Fountain Renovation; and authorize the City Clerk to advertise for sealed bids.
7.4 CIP No. 2022-03
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-03, IMPERIAL HIGHWAY PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO WICKER DRIVE - REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a contract change order in the amount of $206,519.40.
7.5 CIP No. 2018-03
7.6
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-04, BEHRINGER PARK IMPROVEMENTS PRELIMINARY RENOVATION PLAN AND FINAL DESIGN – APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH DAVID VOLZ DESIGN - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and David Volz Design to provide professional design services for CIP No. 2023-04, Behringer Park Improvements Preliminary Renovation Plan and Final Design, based on the David Volz Design proposal dated May 5, 2023, in the amount of $408,499 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services to David Volz Design, if required, for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
7.6 CIP No. 2023-04
7.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-05, LEFFINGWELL ROAD LANDSCAPE AND MEDIAN IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT FROM TELEGRAPH ROAD TO STAMY ROAD – APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH WILLDAN ENGINEERING - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and Willdan Engineering to provide professional design services for CIP No. 2023-05, Leffingwell Road Landscape and Median Improvements Project from Telegraph Road to Stamy Road, based on the Willdan Engineering proposal dated May 5, 2023 in the amount of $216,956 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services to Willdan Engineering if required, for up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount.
7.7 CIP No. 2023-05
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-02, ALONDRA BOULEVARD PAVEMENT REHABILITATION FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO MOTTLEY DRIVE - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK AND APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by R.J. Noble Company; authorize the City Manager to execute the Balancing Contract Change Order in the amount of $100,707.67; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.8 CIP No. 2018-02
